title: user.merged
description: Two accounts became one (stapel-auth 0.30.0): from_user_id ceased to exist and every row that named it belongs to into_user_id now. This module keeps the SURVIVOR's profile and archives the merged one (ProfileCore.merged_into) rather than deleting it; follows and blocks move to the survivor, dropping any row that would duplicate one it already holds or point it at itself. Nothing is copied onto the survivor — a merge is not a registration. Idempotent: the second delivery reports zeroes.
